sentences.en: Instead she merely looked surprised and - could it be - amused.
sentences.zh: 1. 她只是显得很惊讶——也许还带点笑意。

sentences.en: You shouldn't live merely in pursuit of your own happiness.
sentences.zh: 2. 你不应该仅仅为了追求自己的幸福而活着。

sentences.en: Don't look down on him merely because he is poor.
sentences.zh: 3. 别因为他穷就瞧不起他。
